_comment: Default credentials and session policy, bundled with the Worker so a fresh deploy works immediately. To change credentials WITHOUT redeploying, put a document of this same shape in the AUTH_KV namespace under the key 'auth:config' (live within ~60s) or in the AUTH_CONFIG secret (live on the next cold start). Layers are merged, so a KV document containing only 'users' keeps the session policy from here. Generate a passwordHash block with: node tools/hash-password.mjs <username>
_siteSalt: Public domain separator mixed into the per-user client salt. Changing it invalidates every passwordHash, so regenerate them all if you do.
_iterations: clientIterations is the PBKDF2 work factor run in the browser; it is the one that actually protects the password offline. serverIterations is deliberately small so the Worker stays inside the 10ms CPU budget of the Free plan. Raise serverIterations only on a paid plan.
_users: Default login is ungalot / password.. — change it before this is of any real use. Each entry needs either a passwordHash block (recommended) or a plaintext 'password' (convenient, logged as a warning, and costs CPU on the first login after a cold start).
_session: ttlMinutes is the hard ceiling on a session. idleMinutes ends it early if the tab goes unused; it slides forward on every /api/session call.
_allowedOrigins: Browser origins permitted to call the API. Leave the localhost entries in place for local development; they cannot be reached from anywhere else.
_rateLimit: Per-IP throttle on failed logins. Enforced with KV when AUTH_KV is bound, otherwise per-isolate in memory.
_apps: Protected bundles the Worker will serve to an authenticated caller.
